facts.business: Flomic Global Logistics Limited provides end-to-end integrated logistics solutions across air, ocean, and land freight, including freight forwarding, transportation, warehousing, customs clearance, and project logistics through an asset-light model.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Strengthening profitability, improving return ratios and delivering sustainable earnings growth remain key priorities for the Company.

key_risks: Evolving trade patterns and freight market volatility
Supply chain realignments and fluctuating freight rates
facts.related_party_note: All transactions entered into with Related Parties during the financial year 2025-26 were undertaken in compliance with regulatory provisions; there were no materially significant transactions with related parties in conflict with the interest of the Company.
